scope: 9 frozen ETH 15m variants; no EMA/width/protection retuning; Pine unchanged

modes.next_bar_open: 第一根触及后只检查下一根开盘；收回则继续持仓，后来再次触及可以重新开始一次等待
modes.next_bar_touch: 第一根触及后，下一根开盘在止损之外立即退出；否则下一根盘中再次触及退出；整根未触及则重置
modes.next_bar_close: 第一根触及后只检查下一根收盘，仍在止损之外按该收盘退出；否则重置

lock_rule: Only actual initial-stop exits freeze that signal candle high/low at close; block same-bar reentry; later close outside creates one new signal, ordinary entry confirmation and chase cap still apply. Reverse exits and profit protection remain active.
extra_case: immediate 2% without lock, added by user after confirming 1% baseline
nominal_stop_warning: Delayed exits may exceed 1%; not clamped; next bar means next observed 15m bar, never next 5m bar
inference_limit: History has already been examined. Later two years are a descriptive slice, not an untouched validation set. Do not select new parameters after viewing results.
